content:
Emergency crews responded to an incident on McPherson Road in Laredo around 1 p.m. on Saturday, November 7.

Video from the scene showed a Laredo police car and a fire truck/ambulance at an intersection on McPherson Road.

As of Saturday afternoon, officials had not released details about what happened, and no injuries had been reported. Webb Watch 956 will update this story if police or fire officials release more information.

Drivers in the area should use caution and expect delays.

Source: Hammrod News video, November 7, 2026. No official statement from the Laredo Police Department or Laredo Fire Department had been released as of publication.
